mapper.select:
select mn.*, pre.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName from Payment_Review mn left join Pre_Project pre on mn.P_Id= pre.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id=con.Con_Id
and mn.PR_Code like concat('%',#{params.prCode},'%')
and mn.Apply_Unit like concat('%',#{params.applyUnit},'%')
and mn.Apply_Content like concat('%',#{params.applyContent},'%')
and pre.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and con.Con_Name like concat('%',#{params.conName},'%')
and state = #{params.state}
and create_uname like concat('%',#{params.createUname},'%')
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Create_Time desc

select mn.*, pre.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, sys.c_name as cName from Payment_Review mn left join Pre_Project pre on mn.P_Id= pre.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join sys_company sys on sys.c_id = mn.c_id where mn.id=#{id}
